evidence.detail: R107 EditorKitController directly invokes rs/l/b/a/a.a(originalCommand, commandName, args) for every entered Editor Kit command, immediately alongside its own global/entity command parser.
The helper exclusively recognizes the utility/debug command family col/cols/color/colors, finditem, findnpc, itemdef, texture and textures.

The color commands operate on the live EditorEntity list, reset or append selected color IDs to each applicable entity's color-selection list, rebuild the entity and report the resulting selected-color array through EditorKitController.

finditem and findnpc scan live ItemDefinition/NpcDefinition tables up to 40000 IDs, support exclusion terms prefixed with '-', and emit matching name plus numeric ID through EditorKitController output.

itemdef reset rebuilds the ItemDefinitionConfigLoader and definition caches, while itemdef <id> prints exact ItemDefinition model/rotation/offset/equipment/recolor/retexture fields to stdout before resetting the client model state.
texture/textures opens the existing texture/debug UI state and emits the exact notification 'Textures opened' through EditorKitController.

proposals.note: EditorKitUtilityCommandHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the live Editor Kit utility/debug command dispatcher. No surviving original source noun is asserted; confidence is 0.998.
